knowledge:
- key_parameters: groupvar=Used in fitPoisBG to specify a grouping variable (e.g., slide name) to adjust the Poisson background model for batch effects ;; split=Used in diagPoisBG, BGScoreTest, fitNBth, QuanRange, and fitPoisthNorm to indicate whether background values or calculations should be split by the stored groupvar ;; removeoutlier=Used in BGScoreTest to specify whether outlier negative probes should be removed prior to the score test ;; useprior=Used in BGScoreTest to specify whether to use a prior (Beta distribution) for background expression, leading to a more conservative test ;; form=Used in fitNBthDE and fitNBthmDE to specify the formula for the fixed or mixed-effects model design ;; controlRandom=Used in fitNBthmDE to pass a list of tuning parameters (e.g., nu, nmh_e, thin_e) for the random effects model estimation
- alternatives: Q3 (75% quantile) normalization is mentioned as a standard alternative, but the documentation notes that Q3 normalization is prone to low-value spikes and PCA clustering driven by background-to-signal ratios, whereas Poisson threshold normalization (fitPoisthNorm) eliminates these issues.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing transcriptomics data from NanoString GeoMx DSP platforms (such as Whole Transcriptome Atlas data) to perform background-aware QC, normalization, and differential expression modeling that accounts for complex experimental designs (e.g., multiple slides and regions of interest).
- pitfalls: Do not use aggregateCounts from GeomxTools before background modeling, as the background model (fitPoisBG) must work on probe-level data with all negative probes ;; High dispersion (>2) in diagPoisBG indicates over-dispersion (batch effects or large outliers), requiring adjustment via groupvar or outlier removal ;; Mixed-effect models (fitNBthmDE) are computationally intensive and can take hours on full datasets; subsetting features (e.g., to features_high) is highly recommended to speed up analysis.

workflows.name: geomx_dsp_rna_workflow
workflows.intent: Perform background modeling, probe aggregation, target/sample QC, Poisson threshold normalization, and differential expression analysis on NanoString GeoMx DSP RNA data.
input: kidney (NanoStringGeoMxSet object containing probe-level expression data, negative probes, and sample/feature metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Update the GeoMxSet object to the current version using updateGeoMxSet ;; 2. Fit the Poisson background model using negative probes with fitPoisBG and diagnose dispersion with diagPoisBG ;; 3. Aggregate and filter probes based on correlation or score tests using aggreprobe ;; 4. Perform target QC using the background score test with BGScoreTest ;; 5. Estimate signal size factors using the negative binomial threshold model with fitNBth ;; 6. Perform sample QC by filtering low-signal ROIs ;; 7. Fit differential expression models using fixed effects (fitNBthDE) or mixed effects (fitNBthmDE) ;; 8. Extract DE coefficients and generate tables using coefNBth and DENBth ;; 9. Perform Poisson threshold normalization using fitPoisthNorm
workflows.code:
#Update to current NanoStringGeoMxSet version
kidney <- updateGeoMxSet(kidney)

# Background Modeling
kidney <- fitPoisBG(kidney)
set.seed(123)
kidney_diag <- diagPoisBG(kidney)
kidney <- fitPoisBG(kidney, groupvar = "slide name")
set.seed(123)
kidney_diag <- diagPoisBG(kidney, split = TRUE)

# Aggregate function
all0probeidx <- which(rowSums(exprs(kidney))==0)
if (length(all0probeidx) > 0) {
    kidney <- kidney[-all0probeidx, ]
}
kidney <- aggreprobe(kidney, use = "cor")

# Target QC Score test
kidney <- BGScoreTest(kidney)
kidneySplit <- BGScoreTest(kidney, split = TRUE, removeoutlier = FALSE, useprior = FALSE)
kidneyOutliers <- BGScoreTest(kidney, split = FALSE, removeoutlier = TRUE, useprior = FALSE)
kidneyPrior <- BGScoreTest(kidney, split = FALSE, removeoutlier = FALSE, useprior = TRUE)

# Estimate the size factor
set.seed(123)
kidney <- fitNBth(kidney, split = TRUE)
kidney <- QuanRange(kidney, split = FALSE, probs = c(0.75, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95))

# Sample QC
ROIs_high <- sampleNames(kidney)[which((quantile(fData(kidney)[["para"]][, 1],
                                                  probs = 0.90, na.rm = TRUE) -
                                          notes(kidney)[["threshold"]])*kidney$sizefact_fitNBth>2)]

# DE modeling Fixed Effect Model
NBthDEmod <- fitNBthDE(form = ~region,
                       split = FALSE,
                       object = kidney)

# Mixed effect model
set.seed(123)
NBthmDEmod <- fitNBthmDE(object = kidney,
                         form = ~ region+(1|`slide name`),
                         ROIs_high = ROIs_high,
                         split = FALSE,
                         features_all = features_high_subset,
                         preci1=NBthDEmod$preci1,
                         threshold_mean = bgMean,
                         sizescale = TRUE,
                         controlRandom=list(nu=12, nmh_e=400, thin_e=60))

set.seed(123)
NBthmDEmodslope <- fitNBthmDE(object = kidney,
                              form = ~ region+(1+region|`slide name`),
                              ROIs_high = ROIs_high,
                              split = FALSE,
                              features_all = features_high_subset,
                              preci1=NBthDEmod$preci1,
                              threshold_mean = bgMean,
                              sizescale = TRUE,
                              controlRandom=list(nu=12, nmh_e=400, thin_e=60))

# Generate DE result
coeff <- coefNBth(NBthDEmod)
coefr <- coefNBth(NBthmDEmod)
coefrslope <- coefNBth(NBthmDEmodslope)

DEtab <- DENBth(coeff, variable = "regiontubule")
DEtabr <- DENBth(coefr, variable = "regiontubule")
DEtabrslope <- DENBth(coefrslope, variable = "regiontubule")

# Normalization
set.seed(123)
kidney <- fitPoisthNorm(object = kidney,
                        ROIs_high = ROIs_high,
                        threshold_mean = bgMean,
                        sizescalebythreshold = TRUE)

set.seed(123)
kidney <- fitPoisthNorm(object = kidney,
                        split = TRUE,
                        ROIs_high = ROIs_high,
                        threshold_mean = bgMean,
                        sizescalebythreshold = TRUE)
